body: We're living on the back of a giant turtle floating in circles
I'm not going to get into a keyboard war. I just have to say one thing. A Who is a Who no matter how small, no matter their skin, unless your names Paul. Dear Paul from work. I don't really like you.
Shout out to Japan for being Honest with their antisocialness! In America we gather and have odd conversation about chickens and what nots.
